from manim import *

class GVERichScene(MovingCameraScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.frame.set_height(8)
        title = Title("Activation Functions")
        self.play(Write(title))
        self.wait()

        sigmoid_text = Text("Sigmoid Function")
        sigmoid_graph = FunctionGraph(
            lambda x: 1 / (1 + np.exp(-x)),
            x_min=-10,
            x_max=10,
            color=BLUE,
        )
        self.play(
            title.animate.shift(UP * 2),
            FadeIn(sigmoid_text, shift=UP),
            Create(sigmoid_graph),
        )
        self.wait()
        self.play(
            self.camera.frame.animate.shift(DOWN * 2).set_width(10),
            run_time=2,
        )
        self.wait()

        relu_text = Text("ReLU Function")
        relu_graph = FunctionGraph(
            lambda x: np.maximum(0, x),
            x_min=-10,
            x_max=10,
            color=GREEN,
        )
        self.play(
            sigmoid_text.animate.shift(LEFT * 3),
            sigmoid_graph.animate.shift(LEFT * 3),
            FadeIn(relu_text, shift=RIGHT * 2),
            Create(relu_graph, run_time=2),
        )
        self.wait()

        tanh_text = Text("Tanh Function")
        tanh_graph = FunctionGraph(
            lambda x: np.tanh(x),
            x_min=-10,
            x_max=10,
            color=RED,
        )
        self.play(
            sigmoid_text.animate.shift(UP * 2 + LEFT * 3),
            sigmoid_graph.animate.shift(UP * 2 + LEFT * 3),
            relu_text.animate.shift(UP * 2 + RIGHT * 2),
            relu_graph.animate.shift(UP * 2 + RIGHT * 2),
            FadeIn(tanh_text, shift=DOWN * 2),
            Create(tanh_graph, run_time=2),
        )
        self.wait()
        self.play(
            self.camera.frame.animate.set_height(6).set_width(12),
            run_time=2,
        )
        self.wait()

        softmax_text = Text("Softmax Function")
        softmax_graph = FunctionGraph(
            lambda x: np.exp(x) / np.sum(np.exp(x)),
            x_min=-10,
            x_max=10,
            color=YELLOW,
        )
        self.play(
            sigmoid_text.animate.shift(LEFT * 4 + UP * 2),
            sigmoid_graph.animate.shift(LEFT * 4 + UP * 2),
            relu_text.animate.shift(LEFT * 2 + UP * 2),
            relu_graph.animate.shift(LEFT * 2 + UP * 2),
            tanh_text.animate.shift(RIGHT * 2 + UP * 2),
            tanh_graph.animate.shift(RIGHT * 2 + UP * 2),
            FadeIn(softmax_text, shift=DOWN * 2 + RIGHT * 3),
            Create(softmax_graph, run_time=2),
        )
        self.wait()

        self.play(
            self.camera.frame.animate.set_height(8),
            run_time=2,
        )
        self.wait(2)
